shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && rg -n \"lastUsage|afterModelResponse|UsageMetadata\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/ai.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '70,175p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,120p' src/types/ai.ts && sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '220,285p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '480,555p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -60 && sed -n '1,90p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"spec anchor|specs/.+#|@spec|VALIDATED_BY|validated by:\" src specs scripts | head -100 && sed -n '1,70p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n \"scriptedProvider|registryReturning|TOOL_CALL|STOP_FOR_TOOL\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n \"descriptor|spec field|specs/.*#[0-9]+\" .lore scripts --glob '*.mjs' --glob '*.yml' | head -80; sed -n '380,430p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts | sed -n '1,70p' && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && git diff --no-index /dev/null src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts || true && git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts && git commit -m "Sum usage across provider rounds" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main'
